title: Measurement: research is refused at every entry point, before the key, unless the project chose Tavily and this computer granted it
summary: ACC-0120, TSK-0075 (F4) at 70c5ba8 (84b0ae5 and the review fixes in c8354d2). CI run 36244920683 passed all four cells, and the 23 ACC-0120 tests ran and passed in each, none skipped: test/research-permission.test.mjs (19), test/supervisor.test.mjs (2), test/pi-package-tools.test.mjs (2). THE GATE, ON REAL RECORDS IN REAL GIT REPOSITORIES: no project named refuses research-no-project-context; no project record, or one that is not JSON, research-project-record-unreadable; research none or undecided, research-not-chosen; tavily chosen with no answer or a declined grant, research-not-granted; a consent record that is not JSON, or a granted record in a place Git does not ignore, research-consent-unreadable; a local-state mode other than project or user, research-state-mode-unknown. Chosen and granted is permitted. A grant kept in the per-user root (setup --local-state user) is found in user mode and not in project mode. EVERY REASON AT EVERY ENTRY POINT, BEFORE THE KEY: research:search, research:record and research:probe, run as real processes with a preload recording every read of TAVILY_API_KEY and every request, refused with no project named (exit 2) and with each project refusal (exit 1), in every case with no key read and no request. Pi's research_capability, research_search and research_fetch, through the real gate with KILN_PROJECT_ROOT and KILN_STATE_MODE set per case, returned each reason with mustRecordGap and never reached an implementation. The permitted cases, project-local (research:search) and per-user (research:probe --local-state user), read the key and made a request only after the gate. research:record refused research-destination-not-this-project, exit 2, with no request, when PLANNING_CONTENT_DIR pointed at another project's content. THE SUPERVISOR: with research not chosen, TAVILY_API_KEY reached neither the launcher nor the agent, an inherited KILN_PROJECT_ROOT was replaced, the agent alone was told its project root, and the log said the key was withheld; with research chosen and granted, the key passed through and the agent was told its project root and state mode.

omissions.reason: No request reached Tavily: the permitted cases stop at a refused fetch, so the gate is shown and the backend is not.
